name: safeguard-paragon-sacrifice-prevents-noncombat-damage
notes: Safeguard Paragon (apu7wiw3cl, NORM CLERIC/WARRIOR ALLY, reserve 3): "Sacrifice Safeguard Paragon: Prevent the next 4 non-combat damage that would be dealt to each unit you control this turn." Player 1 controls a Safeguard Paragon and a Dungeon Guide. On its own turn player 2 plays Freezing Hail (2 damage to target unit) on that Dungeon Guide; in the priority window player 1 sacrifices the Paragon: every unit player 1 controls gets a PREVENT_NONCOMBAT_4 shield, the Paragon goes to the graveyard, and Freezing Hail's 2 damage is fully prevented (the shield keeps the remaining 2).

rulesClauses: Sacrifice Safeguard Paragon: the sacrifice is the cost (the Paragon goes to the graveyard).
Prevent the next 4 non-combat damage that would be dealt to each unit you control this turn (champion and allies).
